Looking at Panel A of the figure, which shows "2-back performance (mean)" across different age groups:

- 25-30: ~35
- 35-40: ~36 (slightly higher)
- 45-50: ~35.5 (still high, similar to 25-30)
- 55-60: ~33 (noticeable drop)
- 65-70: ~31.5
- 75-80: ~29.5

Performance is relatively stable (within ~1 unit) from ages 25 up to 50. The first significant drop occurs in the 55-60 group.

Therefore, 2-back performance is stable until age 50.
